nick_sales: Heads-up: OrionSys POC next Monday. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (delta), RBAC mappings, and domain locking. Can we scope a 10-day POC?
mira_se: Short: SAML + SCIM 2.0 delta supported. RBAC via SCIM group->role mapping or SAML group claim mapping. Manual CSV import for initial seeding available.
nick_sales: They asked about domain locking / single-tenant domain proofing and whether we support CAA records or only TXT/CNAME. Also want to bring their own KMS if we do Private eval.
tomas_reliability: Domain proofing: TXT or CNAME are supported; CAA isn't used for our verification flow. For Private we accept customer KMS/HSM (we need ARN + access policy during onboarding).
jana_infosec: InfoSec Qs: supported SAML signing algos, assertion encryption, metadata validation, replay protection? We sign with RSA-SHA256, support signed assertions. Encrypted assertions are only available in Private/dedicated test bundles. Replay protection via nonce + timestamp checks.
mira_se: If encrypted assertions are mandatory, Hosted POC won't work. Options: Private eval or quick dedicated test instance (adds ~48-72h).
nick_sales: SCIM throughput/quotas? Will heavy provisioning blow up their usage bill?
mira_se: SCIM calls count under management API tiers, not token-generation. We offer monthly tiers (e.g., up to 50k ops included) and then overage. We'll size based on user count and SCIM cadence.
tomas_reliability: For RBAC, recommend SCIM groups mapping to Redwood roles to keep sync deterministic. If they use nested AD groups, we may need a pre-sync transform or use SAML groupClaim flattening.
jana_infosec: Also prep the security questionnaire: include supported cipher suites (TLS1.2+), audit logging retention (90d default, longer on Dedicated), SOC2 link, pen-test calendar. Note: Hosted does not support encrypted assertions by default  callout required.
ci-bot: quick note: no deployments touching auth in last 48h.
nick_sales: Can someone produce a one-page \"IdOps checklist\" (SAML metadata fields, DNS steps, SCIM token creation, mapping options) + a short answer doc for the security questionnaire by EOD Thursday?
mira_se: I can draft the checklist.
jana_infosec: I'll draft the security answers and call out Hosted limitation and mitigation paths.
tomas_reliability: I'll include session-affinity notes for chat use-cases (recommend Dedicated GPUs for sticky KV cache).
nick_sales: Thanks team  I'll confirm whether encrypted assertions are strict and update OrionSys.
